name: DATE KNIGHT
source:
DATE KNIGHT is a visual novel following you, a Knight-in-training, attending the prestigious Knight University to graduate to become a true, genuine knight in shining armor.

The small beach town of Jeannestown is filled with colorful characters each with their own aspirations and troubles. Meet them and grow closer to uncover their conflicts and secrets as your relationships blossom into something more... and find out the truth lurking within Knight University.

[From [url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/date-knight-a-knight-date-night-dating-simulator#/]Indiegogo[/url]]
translation:
《约会骑士》是一部视觉小说，讲述你作为一名受训骑士，进入著名的骑士大学毕业，成为一名真正的、真正的穿着闪亮盔甲的骑士。

珍尼斯敦这个海滨小镇充满了丰富多彩的人物，每个人都有自己的愿望和烦恼。与他们见面并进一步了解他们的冲突和秘密，随着你们的关系不断发展……并找出潜伏在奈特大学的真相。

[来自[url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/date-knight-a-knight-date-night-dating-simulator#/]Indiegogo[/url]]
